contract: A staged object is not releasable, including after reopen, so local bytes must stay.
Finish publishes the same key, offset, and body. A repeated finish does not create a second object.
Restore rejects a checksum mismatch. Reopen of an untampered publish returns the original key and body.
A payload over the scratch cap stores nothing. Abort drops only the partial. Retention removes a published object and does not mark it releasable.
limits: This store does not delete local log segments. Callers must keep them until releasable is true.
The remote backend is the local PLTIER01 journal, not an object store.
This is not a Kafka tiered-storage RPC.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
